_meta.purpose: Reference facts only: how independent public sources classify each RWS card (upright / reversed) as yes / no / maybe. Not a text source. No third-party prose is stored.
_meta.note: Keys starting with an underscore are metadata; every other key is a card id.
_meta.consensusRule: share = top count / n. share >= 0.70 -> label yes|no|maybe; 0.50 <= share < 0.70 -> lean-<label>; tie -> tie:a/b; share < 0.50 -> split. yesNoConflict = min(yes,no)/n >= 0.25.
_meta.toStarlogLean: yes -> go, maybe -> wait, no -> rethink (default mapping). Reversed consensus is weak (pairwise agreement about 0.42-0.59 vs 0.67-0.84 for upright): derive reversed leans from our own reversedModes instead of trusting the vote.
_meta.independenceWarning: Sources agree with each other at roughly 0.67-0.84 on upright (mostly above 0.74), but many look like variants of one common canon (LLM-era datasets). Counts are raw votes, not proof of independent confirmation. Diabolist is the outlier (0.67).
